GOV.note: P0 + P2 GOV FRs complete. Authored: FR-GOV-001 (reviewer recruit), FR-GOV-002 (co-maintainer recruit). Pending: FR-GOV-003 (P6 RFC cycle).

LAUNCH.scope: Show HN, Product Hunt, cross-posts, outreach playbooks, guest-post pitches, conference CFPs, sponsorships
LAUNCH.note: P1 + P2 LAUNCH FRs complete. Authored: FR-LAUNCH-001 (Show HN), FR-LAUNCH-002 (cross-posts), FR-LAUNCH-003 (Product Hunt), FR-LAUNCH-004 (T-7 personal heads-up), FR-LAUNCH-005 (guest post pitches), FR-LAUNCH-006 (P2 newsletters). CONTENT.note: P2 CONTENT FRs complete. Authored: FR-CONTENT-001 (weekly deep-dives), FR-CONTENT-002 (cross-publishing). Pending: FR-CONTENT-003 (P3 co-author piece).

INTEG.scope: Storybook addon, Tokens Studio export validator, zeroheight reader, third-party tool bridges
INTEG.note: All P2 INTEG FRs complete. Authored: FR-INTEG-001 (Storybook addon @dsaf/storybook-addon, ~1,310 lines, 4 runners), FR-INTEG-002 (Tokens Studio validator @dsaf/tokens-validator, ~1,180 lines, 9 validators for A.1), FR-INTEG-003 (zeroheight reader @dsaf/zeroheight-reader, ~716 lines, 10 validators for A.3 + A.5 subset). The 3 INTEG packages form a cohesive trio sharing the CriterionScore contract + audit_targets convention + cap-rule disclosure footer.

CLI.scope: npx dsaf scan (Core 25 CLI), Mode W generator CLI

BENCH.scope: anonymous benchmark survey (P2 lite) + hosted benchmark.dsaf.dev (P4)
BENCH.note: P2 BENCH FR complete. Authored: FR-BENCH-001 (lite anonymous benchmark on dsaf.dev). Pending: FR-BENCH-002 (P4 hosted benchmark.dsaf.dev).

FUNNEL.scope: paid funnel CTA on dsaf.dev, Cal.com booking, tiered case studies, pricing rules, EU/US audit-lead partnership

VERT.scope: Govtech vertical pack (only Govtech, only P5+, only with named EU public-sector buyer)

CERT.scope: DSAF certification — free self-attestation badge + paid verified tier

REPORT.scope: annual DSAF State of Design System Audits report

I18N.note: P2 I18N FR complete. Authored: FR-I18N-001 (JP/ES/DE translations of DSAF-25 Core + landing). Pending: FR-I18N-002 (P5 FR/PT + full 125 + deep-dive translation cadence).

P0.name: Pre-launch hardening
P0.exit_gate: DSAF-25 on one page; dsaf.dev resolves; 84.6% headline removed; L0-L5 + radar SVG in /assets/; README HN-ready; no-silent-regression rule; 2+ named endorsements in README — ALL GATES MET

P1.name: Launch
P1.exit_gate: Show HN posted; >=300 stars in launch week; >=2 named endorsements; >=1 conference CFP submitted; 5-15 qualified inbound leads — ALL P1 FRs SHIPPED (CFP-related is FR-LAUNCH-007 in P3)

P2.name: Community velocity
P2.exit_gate: 500-1000 stars; >=1 PR from non-CyberSkill DS-team engineer; >=1 podcast appearance booked; >=1 integration shipped; co-maintainer announced; 3 translations open — ALL P2 FRs SHIPPED (post-launch metric outcomes vs FR completion deliberately distinguished)

P3.name: Industry positioning
P3.exit_gate: Cited in zeroheight 2026 OR Sparkbox survey; talk accepted at Into Design Systems Conf 2027; public audit of marquee OSS DS shipped

P4.name: Paid funnel optimization
P4.exit_gate: 60-150 cumulative inbound leads; $80K-$250K Year-1 audit revenue; benchmark.dsaf.dev live; EU/US audit lead onboarded; Tier-1 floor at $4.9K

P5.name: Framework v0.2+
P5.exit_gate: Mode W shipped; npx dsaf scan returns Core 25 score in 60s; hosted Pro tier at $39/mo; Govtech pack with named EU buyer

P6.name: Sustained leadership
P6.exit_gate: Annual DSAF report published; certification badges issued (>=50 self-attested, >=5 verified); quarterly RFC cycle active; one Into Design Systems track sponsored or co-hosted
